title: Oh! Father

ai_content.desc_en: Oh! Father tells the story of Yukio, a typical high school student in every way except that he's an only child in a family of five, due to the fact that he has four fathers, each with their own unique personalities and interests. The only thing they share in common is their love of their son. When Yukio witnesses a robbery, he becomes involved in a bizarre string of incidents involving his fathers.
